items.headline: US AI chip curbs stall billions in Asia data center loans and deals
items.note: Lenders are pausing loans tied to Chinese tech giants and one bank is declining a $372M Digital Halo underwriting, showing syndication stress spreading to Asian data-center credit.

items.headline: AI debt worries grow as Nvidia rebound masks Big Tech spending squeeze
items.note: Heavy AI spenders and debt issuers such as Oracle and Alphabet are down 25-45% from their June peaks, per Man analysis, which tightens the funding backdrop for AI borrowers.

items.headline: Banks start selling AI data center loans as construction delays pile up
items.note: ING and SocGen have listed up to $800M of data-center loans, and HSBC reportedly sold about $300M of a New Mexico project loan at a discount, so lenders are trimming exposure.
